brief.headline: Push price toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc and extend payment to 45 days, freeing ₹2.39 L cash for us — their finances aren't public so lean on market data and line up Manjushree as a second source.

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc for the 28 mm cap at our volume
priceAsk.basis: Open market asking prices for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap run ₹0.55–1.20/pc, with ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical; the verdict says 'modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec' — we spend ₹58.17 L a year with them, so we have the volume to hit that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Extend payment from 30 days to 45 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Moves from 30 to 45 days and frees ₹2.39 L cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Suraj's finances aren't public, so we can't see their profit or cash position. That means we build our case on what we do know: we spend ₹58.17 L a year with them (a material customer), the open market shows room to negotiate down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc, and we have four strong alternates ready to qualify. Without financial transparency, our leverage comes from demonstrating we've done the homework and have backup options — push firmly but fairly on price and terms, and make it clear we're qualifying a second source in parallel.

evidence.point: We spend ₹58.17 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
Market asking prices for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap sit in a ₹0.55–1.20/pc band, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
The market verdict says there is modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser specs
Extending payment 15 days (30 to 45) frees up ₹2.39 L cash for us
HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg as a raw-material reference

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (private, ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter covering pharma bottles, caps and preforms — flagged as a top second-source candidate with strong scale and health

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (listed, ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader in pails, containers and pharma packaging — profitable and robust, a credible alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (manufacturer, India-Pan)
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — pan-India resin and packaging manufacturer with medium confidence

risks: Suraj publishes no financial statements, so we fly blind on their profit, debt and cash — if they're fragile we won't see it until a delivery hiccup.

We have no internal benchmark (no other vendor for this exact item) — our price case rests entirely on the market ask data, so they may push back that it doesn't reflect our exact spec or order pattern.
Pushing too hard without a qualified second source in hand could leave us scrambling if Suraj walks or cuts us off — start the Manjushree and Mold-Tek technical audits now.
The market backups (Reliance, IVL Dhunseri, others) are leads only — none are qualified or priced yet, so don't name them in the room as live alternates.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We've spent ₹58.17 L with you this year and we'd like to grow that, but we need your help closing the gap to market — caps like ours are trading at ₹0.65–0.80 at volume, and we'd like to move toward that band while extending terms to 45 days.
